objective: Prepare the human-requested v0.2.0 software release by synchronizing package metadata, documenting the merged main-branch capabilities, and preserving explicit simulation, hardware, and safety evidence boundaries.
forbidden: runtime behavior changes beyond the reported software version
claims of Gazebo, physical robot, procurement, certification, or hardware release readiness
acceptance: all distributable package and health-endpoint version metadata reports 0.2.0
English and Chinese READMEs identify v0.2.0 as the current software release and describe only capabilities merged into main
README evidence boundaries keep scripted fixtures, Gazebo, MoveIt execution, camera, BSP image, and physical hardware claims separate
deployment examples reference the published v0.2.0 image tag
the release diff excludes every open pull request
repository required checks pass before tagging
evidence: published v0.2.0 tag and GitHub Release URL
stop_conditions: the human owner has not explicitly requested publication
main changes after release validation and before tagging
a required check or release-image job fails
release notes would require an unmerged or ineligible physical claim
